name: codeapi
description: Local VS Code automation over HTTP with extension-host execution and controllable PTY terminals.

codeapi.pythonPath.description: Explicit interpreter for dev mode. Empty = bundled runtime if present, otherwise python.exe on Windows or python3 on macOS/Linux.

codeapi.securityPolicy.description: Security policy for the runtime. 'restricted' disables /exec, /command, and custom shell/args on /term/create. 'open' re-enables them for legacy tooling. Machine scope: cannot be overridden by workspace settings.

codeapi.gateRoot.description: Path to the .command-gate directory for write-gate verification. Empty disables gate checking. Machine scope: cannot be overridden by workspace settings.
